title: cyclobalanopsis macrocalyx var. litoralis
intro: Cyclobalanopsis macrocalyx var. litoralis, commonly known as Litoralis Oak, is a plant species belonging to the Fagaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The health benefits of Litoralis Oak include lowering cholesterol levels and preventing the formation of blood clots, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Litoralis Oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
